## Description

Settings → Staff: table (Name, Role, Access, MFA, Status) and "Add staff member": role picker with descriptions (receptionist, nurse, care coordinator, practice admin; doctors redirected to Add doctor) → facility scope and hours → permissions (locked rows from the role cannot be granted/removed here) → invite. Custom roles composed from capabilities.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Choosing "Doctor" shows "Doctors need licence verification. Use Settings → Doctors → Add doctor." and does not create a staff membership.
- [ ] **AC2.** Locked permissions from a built-in role are displayed but not editable; custom roles cannot exceed the capabilities of practice admin.
- [ ] **AC3.** The invite uses the P0 flow; the staff table shows invited/active/suspended/offboarded and MFA enrolment state.
- [ ] **AC4.** Every permission change is written to the audit log ("Every change is written to the audit log").
- [ ] **AC5.** A receptionist created here cannot open clinical endpoints (security test reused from P0).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
